info.name: ilert REST Alert Actions Incidents API

params.name: start-index
params.description: an integer specifying the starting point (beginning with 0) when paging through a list of entities

params.name: max-results
params.description: the maximum number of results when paging through a list of incidents. (Note: when using ?include maximum is reduced to 25)

params.name: include
params.description: Describes optional properties that should be included in the response. You may declare multiple. (subscribed)

params.name: services
params.description: service IDs of the incident's affected services

params.name: from
params.description: from date, ISO-UTC e.g. 2021-05-25T21:24:56.771Z, based on reportTime

params.name: until
params.description: until date, ISO-UTC e.g. 2021-05-26T21:24:56.771Z, based on reportTime

items.docs: Note: depending on affected services this will publish notifications to subscribers. Use /publish-info to forecast notifications.

info.name: Forecast the affected subscribers and status pages

items.docs: Forecast the affected subscribers and status pages as well as notifications that would be send out due to created or update incident.

params.name: include
params.description: Describes optional properties that should be included in the response. You may declare multiple. (subscribed, affectedTeams, history)

items.docs: Note: returns an ETag header that can be send to the PUT /incidents/{id} resource as If-Match header to return a 412 Error in case any related resources e.g. Services or Incident have been updated in the mean time.
Note: the update will be automatically appended to the incident's update history and publish notifications to subscribers.
